guide.title: How do I work here?
guide.summary: What an automation is, and the useful path
guide.heading: Describe a trigger and a controlled preparation
guide.intro: An automation is a sequence that starts on a signal. It links an event to a preparation or a task; it never replaces your approval to send.
guide.step1: Pick the scenario that suits your organisation.
guide.step2: Check the criteria, internal recipients and exclusions.
guide.step3: Test the trigger and inspect what was created.
guide.keep: An automation starts off. What it prepares lands in To handle; nothing leaves without your action.

chain.humanBody: Open the result, check it and decide what happens next.

stops.title: What stops the follow-up
stops.body: The same signal never triggers the rule twice. A contact already in a sequence, reached less than 30 days ago, opted out of prospecting or a customer is set aside, and the rule records it. Turned off or archived, it no longer runs.

tools.title: Required tools and starting template capability

try.body: The test reads your workspace data. It creates no task and no message.
try.pausedPromise: No new run while paused: the trial only reads for you.

actions.testToActivate: Test the flow to be able to activate. Any change puts the rule back to draft.

archive.title: Archive this automation?
archive.body: The rule turns off and leaves the list. The tasks, drafts and proofs already created are kept.

toast.draftSaved: Version {{version}} saved as a draft. The current version keeps running.

settings.title: Adjust this automation
settings.description: What you change here becomes a draft: the running rule does not move until you have tested and activated it.
settings.name: Automation name
settings.capHelp: Leave empty for no cap. At the cap, the rule sets the signal aside and records it.
settings.externalSendBody: Never on its own: every send goes through your approval, immediate or scheduled. A preparation does not give permission to send.
settings.resetsTest: Any change puts the configuration back to draft and requires a new test before activation.

remove.title: Delete this rule?
remove.body: It is removed for good. Prefer “Archive” if you want to keep its tasks, drafts and proofs.

switch.title: Before switching
switch.error: The comparison could not be loaded: you can’t switch without having seen it.
switch.noDifferences: No setting changes between the two versions.
switch.migrationEngaged_one: {{count}} firing already logged stays as it is: it is neither replayed nor erased. The new version only picks up signals not seen yet.
switch.migrationEngaged_other: {{count}} firings already logged stay as they are: they are neither replayed nor erased. The new version only picks up signals not seen yet.
switch.migrationNone: Nothing has been logged for this rule yet: there is nothing to carry over.
switch.migrationSignal: Version {{to}} listens to a different signal: what version {{from}} already picked up stays attached to the old signal.
switch.impactMeasured_one: Read without running anything, version {{version}} would act this morning on {{count}} situation out of {{read}} read.
switch.impactMeasured_other: Read without running anything, version {{version}} would act this morning on {{count}} situations out of {{read}} read.
switch.impactUnmeasured: Impact not measured: this rule’s source could not be read right now. You can still switch.
switch.kept: Version {{version}} is kept: nothing is deleted.
